response.justification: Bogdan far exceeds the 6+ years requirement with ~15 years of full-stack experience, including recent, directly relevant work in TypeScript/Node.js, React, MongoDB, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and — notably — AI-agent infrastructure (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks), which is a rare and explicitly requested skill. He has a CS degree, deep testing/TDD credibility (built his own test runner and assertion library, taught Selenium/TDD courses), and a track record of architecture and performance work at scale. Gaps are mostly framework-specific rather than fundamental: Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, and Kotlin are not mentioned, and a large share of his deep systems work is in DLang, a niche language. Given his demonstrated polyglot adaptability, these are low-risk gaps worth probing in interview.
strengths: Hands-on AI-agent/MCP tooling experience matching a hard-to-find requirement
Deep TypeScript/Node + React + AWS/K8s full-stack delivery at product scale
Exceptional testing and craftsmanship credentials (TDD, own test tooling, teaching)
concerns: No explicit Nest.js, Vitest/Jest, or Kotlin experience listed
Significant investment in niche DLang stack over mainstream ecosystems
Frontend depth (React) evidenced in only one recent role; Ember elsewhere

key_factors.factor: Depth and breadth of full-stack TypeScript/Node experience
Missing specific stack items (Nest.js, Vitest, Kotlin)
